message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "validate_diagnostic_inference_with_clinical_context", "description": "Prevent misdiagnosis when interpreting imaging classifier scores by requiring clinical correlation for conditions with overlapping radiological features but distinct temporal profiles.", "applicable_conditions": "When using single-image classification tools to infer a specific diagnosis or disease progression, particularly when the differential diagnosis includes conditions with similar visual markers but different resolution timelines (e.g., ARDS vs. EIPH vs. pneumonia).", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["clinical_history_lookup", "chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns high confidence for a diagnosis based on opacity patterns: (1) Do NOT accept the score as definitive evidence of severity or progression mechanism. (2) Call `clinical_history_lookup` to retrieve patient history, onset timing, and comorbidities. (3) Cross-reference the imaging findings with the clinical timeline; reject diagnoses where the implied progression (e.g., rapid resolution) contradicts the typical natural history of the predicted condition unless supported by explicit clinical data."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
